claim_boundaries.analytical: Primary analytical evidence is a new synthetic holdout. Microscopic studies use actual SUMO with synthetic demand and preferences. OSM studies use real geometry with synthetic OD demand. TTC, PET and DRAC are surrogate conflict indicators, never crash probabilities.
claim_boundaries.microscopic: Actual SUMO paired conditions with synthetic demand/preferences. Seed-disjoint development, calibration, validation and final holdout roles. Surrogate safety is not crash probability.
claim_boundaries.real_topology: Six prespecified synthetic OD pairs on committed real OSM geometry; not observed Seoul traffic.

final_questions.10_permanent_baseline_fallback: The frozen policy permanently falls back for strong shift, LOW_CONTROL and PARTIAL_CONTROL analytical cells without a validated threshold, illegal route sets, nonpositive corrected micro benefit, low micro success probability, or a micro safety UCB veto.
final_questions.1_v4_analytical_but_not_stress_or_sumo: v4 used a global synthetic-domain gate. Its historical 50%-penetration precision was 0.40, stress precision was 0.4409, and its only SUMO intervention was unsafe. The missing regime and domain bridge allowed synthetic calibration to be mistaken for transfer.
final_questions.2_penetration_explanatory_power: Penetration is a dominant activation variable, but not a sufficient microscopic success explanation. In v5 analytical holdout, p=1.0 produced 128/132 interventions at 0.8516 precision; p=0.25 and p=0.50 produced none. In SUMO, p=1.0 produced 7/10 selected interventions but only one success and one unsafe case.
final_questions.3_regime_vs_global: Only slightly on analytical holdout: V5-R precision/coverage were 0.8309/0.1328 versus global 0.8271/0.1299. This small gain did not transfer to full SUMO.
final_questions.4_dss_predicts_failure: Weakly descriptive, not operationally supported. Mild-shift SUMO cases had lower raw success (0.10 versus 0.222 in-distribution), but DSS did not improve stress precision over the no-DSS ablation; H22 fails.
final_questions.5_analytical_to_sumo_bias: Across all 100 SUMO pairs, mean analytical probability minus realized success was +0.0083. Selection bias was more important: the ten selected cases had mean corrected-benefit overprediction +0.0218, yielding 0.10 realized precision.
final_questions.6_safety_veto_removes_unsafe: Mostly, but not completely. Always-adapt B6 had 25 unsafe cases; the selective policy reduced this to one among ten interventions. Because zero was required, the veto fails.
final_questions.7_precision80_with_coverage15_to20: Not with the frozen v5 policy. It retained 0.8258 precision but reached only 0.1289 coverage.
final_questions.8_unseen_stress_precision70: Yes for the analytical stress domain: precision was 0.8519, coverage 0.1055, safety violations zero.
final_questions.9_safe_beneficial_osm_intervention: No. All 48 conditions across six legal stratified OSM OD pairs abstained.

H21_regime_conditioning.finding: Frozen holdout V5-R slightly improved both precision and coverage over V5-G.

H22_DSS.finding: DSS retained zero safety violations but did not improve stress precision over the no-DSS ablation.

H23_micro_safety_gate.finding: The safety gate reduced analytical activation to zero and still allowed one microscopic false-safe intervention.

H24_micro_correction.finding: Microscopic benefit correction slightly worsened final-holdout MAE.

H25_safe_micro_success.finding: There was one safe success, but precision was 0.10 and one safety violation occurred.

H26_selectivity_mechanism.finding: Selectivity removed all analytical safety violations and 24/25 microscopic unsafe adaptations, but not the last false-safe case.

H27_hierarchical_or_mixture.finding: Model selection chose regime-specific M3, not the hierarchical or mixture candidates.

H28_penetration_interactions.finding: The interaction model did not jointly improve validation coverage and Brier score over its nested global comparator.

outcome_reason: Final microscopic safety failure forces Outcome F despite analytical precision and stress precision passing.

posthoc_metric_correction.issue: The frozen microscopic summary populated system_ttt_gain for abstentions before summarize_selective_policy.
posthoc_metric_correction.scope: reporting aggregation only; frozen decisions and success/safety labels unchanged
